families.name: HSA
families.quoteMinimum: Source PN + validated HSA size/connection/duty context
families.searchBehavior: Show grouped HSA variants; do not collapse vague auger searches to one family
families.compatibilityGate: HSA ID + connection + duty/bolt pattern + application context
families.authority: Controlled HSA source plus current intake sources

families.name: HSA Cutterheads / Components
families.required: HSA_ID or Size_Diameter; Connection_Family_Interface; Cutterhead style
families.optional: Bit holder; bit type; wear components; duty class
families.quoteMinimum: Source PN + cutterhead style + connection + customer preference
families.searchBehavior: Display all cutterhead styles in the connection family unless specified
families.authority: Older HSA cutterhead framework retained for control logic

families.name: HSA Center Plugs
families.required: HSA_ID or Size_Diameter; Rod_Family; Bit/assembly style
families.optional: Plug number; pilot bit; bolt number; hex connection
families.quoteMinimum: Authoritative center plug chart row with size and rod connection
families.searchBehavior: Route center plug searches to chart view first
families.compatibilityGate: HSA size + rod family + pilot bit/assembly style
families.authority: Center Plug Assemblies chart treated as active source

families.name: Drill Rods
families.searchBehavior: Search rod family and length directly; ask family when unclear
families.authority: Current filtered intake: 5 ft and 10 ft AW/AWJ/NW/NWJ only

families.name: Core Tooling
families.optional: Barrel length; inner/outer tube; lifter; bit/reaming shell
families.quoteMinimum: Source PN except ignored Boart Longyear column
families.searchBehavior: Search by core size/component role; group complete setup vs replacements
families.compatibilityGate: Core size + component type + bit/reaming/shell context

families.name: Samplers
families.quoteMinimum: PN fields blank until updated source approved
families.searchBehavior: Use descriptions to shape future sampler fields; do not quote PNs
families.compatibilityGate: Sampler size + TPI + rod connection + component role

families.name: Threaded / Hex Adapters
families.optional: Thread family; pin/box direction; hex size
families.quoteMinimum: PN fields blank for threaded adapters until updated source approved
families.searchBehavior: Search connection phrases; label formatting-only where required
families.authority: Threaded adapter PNs blank; Hex adapters mixed by source

families.name: Handling / Retrieval
families.searchBehavior: Search retriever, hook, lifter, slip ring, hoist plug
families.compatibilityGate: Part identity + source status + application context
families.authority: Some handling docs formatting only; source status controls output

families.name: Water Swivels
families.optional: Feed style; rod interface; replacement status
families.quoteMinimum: PNs need updating, not quote-ready from current intake
families.searchBehavior: Search descriptions only until updated source
families.authority: Water swivel docs are formatting/description only

families.name: Future Tooling Family
families.quoteMinimum: Source authority + required attributes defined before quote-ready
families.searchBehavior: Searchable through universal index, then routed for review
families.authority: For categories not represented in v0.3
